instruction: Help me add John Doe's business card from Documents to Contacts, then change his phone number to +17182913280, and save the changes.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to get the value of phones of (first person whose name is "John Doe")' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "17182913280" && osascript -e 'tell application "Contacts" to get the value of emails of (first person whose name is "John Doe")' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "john.doe@apple.com" && echo "True" || echo "False"
